correctness.rationale: A cut after the i-th sorted site is present exactly when the intervening spacing exceeds the sum of its two predecessor and two successor gaps. Dirichlet spacing normalization cancels, giving a bounded stationary 4-dependent exponential-clock process. Explicit exact Gamma/exponential integrals yield cut intensity 7/54, mutually exclusive lags 1/2, joint probabilities 2071/90000 at lag 3 and 6389/324000 at lag 4. The exact covariance summation yields variance slope 5747/90000, which is strictly positive. The standard bounded finite-dependent CLT supplies the infinite normal limit. The delivered checker independently builds graphs and tests the cut criterion on complete gap-permutation families; finite tests supplement, not replace, analytic proof.

value.rationale: The connected-component count measures fragmentation of a natural sparse geometric proximity network. In the first nontrivial fixed 2NN case, the exact rational density, finite covariance structure and variance-to-mean ratio 2463/5000 quantify dependent breaks and strong underdispersion. These are reproducible model-specific benchmark quantities not determined by generic central limit theorems; their value does not rely on claiming that Gaussian convergence itself is novel.
